SELECT tasp.process_id, ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_city, ta.applicant_email1, ta.applicant_email2, ta.applicant_home_phone, ta.applicant_home_phone_is_invalid, ta.applicant_cell_phone, ta.applicant_cell_phone_is_invalid, ta.applicant_work_phone, ta.applicant_work_phone_is_invalid, ta.applicant_working_since,ta.applicant_position_id, ta.applicant_step_id, ta.applicant_date_created, ta.source_id, ta.applicant_joined, ta.applicant_date_joined, ta.applicant_current_employer, ta.user_id, ta.current_ctc, ta.current_ctc_date, ta.expected_ctc, ta.expected_ctc_date, ta.applicant_notice_period, ta.applicant_level_offered, ta.applicant_designation_offered, ta.offered_ctc,tp.position_id, tp.position_code, tp.position_title, tp.position_no_of_openings, tp.position_date_created,tp.position_date_expiry,tp.position_date_closed, tp.dept_id, tp.position_status, tp.sub_dept_id, tp.sub_sub_dept_id, tp.position_level, tp.position_note, tp.position_requested_by, tasp.process_date_created, tp.type_of_vacancy,tp.requirements, tp.position_min_exp, tp.position_max_exp, Case when tp.position_priority=0 then 'low' else Case when tp.position_priority=1 then 'medium' else 'high' end end AS 'Priority', position_date_approved, position_date_opend, ( select tp1.approval_user_ids from tp_positions tp1 where tp1.position_id=tp.position_id
) AS approval_users, (SELECT count(distinct (tasp.applicant_id)) from tp_applicant_selection_process tasp where tasp.position_id=tp.position_id) as applicants_submitted, (SELECT count(distinct (tasp.applicant_id)) from tp_applicant_selection_process tasp, tp_position_steps tps, tp_step_master tsm, tp_step_level tsl where tasp.position_step_id_from = tps.position_step_id and tps.step_id = tsm.step_id and tsm.step_level=tsl.step_level and tsl.step_level ='0' and tasp.position_step_id_to in ('0','-4','-6','-7') and tasp.position_id=tp.position_id) as screen_rejected, (SELECT count(distinct (tasp.applicant_id)) from tp_applicant_selection_process tasp where tasp.position_id=tp.position_id and tasp.applicant_id not in (SELECT distinct (tasp.applicant_id) from tp_applicant_selection_process tasp, tp_position_steps tps, tp_step_master tsm, tp_step_level tsl where tasp.position_step_id_from = tps.position_step_id and tps.step_id = tsm.step_id and tsm.step_level=tsl.step_level and tsl.step_level ='0' and tasp.position_step_id_to in ('0','-4','-6','-7') and tasp.position_id=tp.position_id)) as applicants_screened, (SELECT group_concat(drop_comment) FROM tp_positions_dropped_info tpdi WHERE tpdi.position_id=tp.position_id) as position_drop_comment, (SELECT group_concat(date_dropped) FROM tp_positions_dropped_info tpdi WHERE tpdi.position_id=tp.position_id) as position_drop_date, (select count(*) from tp_applicant_joining_history ta where ta.position_id=tp.position_id) as joined, (select max(date_created) from tp_applicant_joining_history ta where ta.position_id=tp.position_id) as last_joining_date, ( SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT location_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tp_location_ap WHERE location_id IN (SELECT location_id FROM tp_position_locations WHERE position_id=tp.position_id) ) AS positionLocation, (SELECT concat(USER_FNAME,' ',USER_LNAME) FROM tp_users tu WHERE tu.user_id=tp.position_requested_by) AS requisitioner,
( SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT bu_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tp_business_unit WHERE bu_id IN (SELECT bu_id FROM tp_position_business_unit WHERE position_id=tp.position_id) ) AS positionBusinessUnit,
( SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT cost_center_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tp_cost_center WHERE cost_center_id IN (SELECT cost_center_id FROM tp_position_cost_center WHERE position_id=tp.position_id) ) AS positionCostCenter,
(SELECT concat(USER_FNAME,' ',USER_LNAME) FROM tp_users tu WHERE tu.user_id=tp.position_owner_id) AS positionOwner,
(SELECT band_name FROM tp_budget_bands tbb WHERE tbb.band_id=tp.band_id) AS positionBand,
(SELECT grade_name FROM tp_budget_grades tbg WHERE tbg.grade_id=tp.grade_id) AS positionGrade,
(SELECT budget_item_name FROM tp_budget_items tbi WHERE tbi.budget_item_id=tp.budget_item_id) AS positionBudgetItemName,
(SELECT dept_name FROM tp_departments WHERE dept_id=tp.dept_id ) AS department, (SELECT dept_name FROM tp_departments WHERE dept_id=tp.sub_dept_id ) AS subDepartment, (SELECT dept_name FROM tp_departments WHERE dept_id=tp.sub_sub_dept_id ) AS subSubdepartment, ts.source_title, tst.source_type, ( SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT skill SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tp_skills WHERE skill_id IN (SELECT skill_id FROM tp_position_skills WHERE position_id=tp.position_id) ) AS skills, ( SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT concat(USER_FNAME,' ',USER_LNAME) SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tp_users tu,tp_position_step_users tpsu, tp_user_roles tur WHERE tu.user_id= tpsu.user_id AND tpsu.position_id=tp.position_id AND tur.user_id=tu.user_id AND tur.role_id=? ) AS recruiter
FROM tp_applicants ta, tp_sources ts, tp_source_types tst, tp_positions tp , (SELECT process_id, applicant_id, position_step_id_from, position_step_id_to, process_date_created, position_id FROM( SELECT process_id, applicant_id, position_step_id_from, position_step_id_to, process_date_created, position_id FROM( SELECT process_id, applicant_id, position_step_id_from, position_step_id_to, process_date_created, position_id FROM( SELECT max(process_id) as process_id, applicant_id, position_step_id_from, position_step_id_to, process_date_created, position_id FROM tp_applicant_selection_process WHERE process_date_created >=? AND process_date_created <=? GROUP BY applicant_id, position_id ) AS x
UNION
SELECT process_id, applicant_id, position_step_id_from, position_step_id_to, process_date_created, position_id FROM( SELECT process_id, applicant_id, position_step_id_from, position_step_id_to, process_date_created, position_id FROM( SELECT max(process_id) as process_id, applicant_id, position_step_id_from, position_step_id_to, process_date_created, position_id FROM tp_applicant_selection_process WHERE process_date_created <? GROUP BY applicant_id, position_id ) AS x ) AS y WHERE position_step_id_to NOT IN (?,?,?,?,?)
) AS z ORDER BY process_id DESC
) as i GROUP BY applicant_id, position_id) as tasp WHERE tasp.position_id=tp.position_id AND tasp.applicant_id = ta.applicant_id AND ts.source_id=ta.source_id AND ts.source_type_id=tst.source_type_id @@

SELECT * FROM( SELECT tasp.process_id, tasp.applicant_id, tasp.position_id, tasp.position_step_id_from, tasp.position_step_id_to, tasp.process_date_created, tps.position_step_isscheduled,tps.position_step_title, (SELECT position_step_level FROM tp_position_steps itps WHERE itps.position_step_id=tasp.position_step_id_to) AS position_step_level_to, tapo.appointment_from_date, (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT concat(USER_FNAME,' ',USER_LNAME) SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tp_users tu, tp_appointment_attendees taa WHERE tapo.appointment_id=taa.appointment_id AND taa.attendee_id=tu.user_id) AS interviewers, (SELECT concat(USER_FNAME,' ',USER_LNAME) FROM tp_users tu LEFT JOIN tp_user_roles tur ON (tu.user_id=tur.user_id) WHERE tu.user_id=tasp.user_id AND ( tur.role_id=? OR tur.role_id=?) ) AS recruiter, tps.position_step_level FROM tp_applicant_selection_process tasp LEFT JOIN tp_position_steps tps ON (tasp.position_id=tps.position_id AND tasp.position_step_id_from = tps.position_step_id) LEFT JOIN tp_appointments tapo ON(tasp.position_id=tapo.position_id AND tasp.applicant_id=tapo.applicant_id AND tasp.position_step_id_from = tapo.position_step_id @@ ) WHERE tasp.applicant_id=? AND tasp.position_id=? AND process_id <=? AND process_id >=(SELECT process_id FROM tp_applicant_selection_process WHERE applicant_id=? AND position_id=? AND process_id <=? AND position_step_id_from=? ORDER BY process_id DESC LIMIT 0,1) ORDER BY process_id, tapo.appointment_from_date DESC ) as x GROUP BY process_id
select distinct position_id as applicant_position_id from tp_applicant_joining_history
